results.operator_explanation: Problem: summed_bus_headroom_risk. alternative_tradeoffs.alternative_reason: Live vocal dynamics can be performance phrasing or mic distance; a bounded manual level ride review preserves tone before changing compressor behavior mid-show.
alternative_tradeoffs.operator_check: Check loud words, phrase endings, vocal bus headroom and whether the issue is performance dynamics before considering compression.
alternative_tradeoffs.wing_osc_applicable_corrections_policy: Only corrections backed by WING Rack fw3.0.5 native OSC paths may be promoted to WING-applicable candidates; everything else remains analysis_only or operator_review.

alternative_tradeoffs.alternative_reason: Low-mid buildup is the dominant evidence; a bounded cut fixes it fastest.
alternative_tradeoffs.operator_check: Listen for body loss and verify the band is not a feedback notch.
alternative_tradeoffs.wing_osc_applicable_corrections_policy: Only corrections backed by WING Rack fw3.0.5 native OSC paths may be promoted to WING-applicable candidates; everything else remains analysis_only or operator_review.

alternative_tradeoffs.alternative_reason: High-pass cleanup is safer than boosting presence when low spill is present.
alternative_tradeoffs.operator_check: Check that the source still has enough fundamental weight.

alternative_tradeoffs.alternative_reason: Low-mid buildup is dynamic; dynamic EQ controls muddy phrases without permanently thinning the vocal.
alternative_tradeoffs.operator_check: Check chest/body on quiet words and gain reduction on loud phrases.
alternative_tradeoffs.wing_osc_applicable_corrections_policy: Only corrections backed by WING Rack fw3.0.5 native OSC paths may be promoted to WING-applicable candidates; everything else remains analysis_only or operator_review.

alternative_tradeoffs.alternative_reason: Crest/LRA evidence shows performance-level dynamics; gentle compression controls jumps without using makeup as a headroom bypass.
alternative_tradeoffs.operator_check: Check gain reduction on loud phrases and verify makeup headroom.

alternative_tradeoffs.alternative_reason: Vocal dynamics need phrase leveling that preserves words and consonants; a source-tuned leveler is more precise than a generic channel compressor.
alternative_tradeoffs.operator_check: Check loud words, quiet phrase endings, sibilance after compression and lead-vocal bus headroom before promotion.

results.operator_explanation: Problem: live_operator_owned_fx_guard. Selected hold_live_operator_owned_fx_for_review because FX evidence is the dominant live problem, but every FX correction would overwrite a WING FX level or model marked operator-owned; holding is safer than choosing an unrelated channel tone cut. Alternatives scored: manual_level_ride_before_compression=0.86, low_mid_corrective_cut=0.85, high_pass_cleanup=0.82, vocal_dynamic_low_mid_de_mud=0.68. Alternative tradeoffs: manual_level_ride_before_compression: live_operator_owned_fx_review_priority:operator_review_before_overwriting_manual_fx (WING OSC not_a_console_mutation); low_mid_corrective_cut: live_operator_owned_fx_review_priority:manual_fx_level_review_precedes_channel_tone_cut (WING OSC native_osc_path_templates_declared); high_pass_cleanup: live_operator_owned_fx_review_priority:manual_fx_level_review_precedes_channel_tone_cut (WING OSC native_osc_path_templates_declared); vocal_dynamic_low_mid_de_mud: live_operator_owned_fx_review_priority:manual_fx_level_review_precedes_channel_tone_cut (WING OSC native_channel_gate_deq_dynamic_eq_osc_path_templates_declared). Selected WING OSC: Behringer WING Rack fw3.0.5 not_a_console_mutation; native_supported=False; status=analysis_only_no_console_write; live_write=False. Selected readback paths: send/{send}/on, send/{send}/lvl, mdl, fxmix. Selected readback status: analysis_review_only_wing_osc_readback_paths_declared_no_live_write. results.operator_explanation: Problem: masking. Selected vocal_masking_level_plane_rebalance because If the masker or vocal is off its Ayaic level plane, balance should be checked before adding EQ complexity. Alternatives scored: level_plane_gain_down=0.87, vocal_intelligibility_static_pocket_eq=0.87, vocal_intelligibility_dynamic_unmasking=0.71, hold_for_level_plane_context=0.48. Alternative tradeoffs: level_plane_gain_down: lower_total_score;total_score_delta=0.010 (WING OSC native_osc_path_templates_declared); vocal_intelligibility_static_pocket_eq: vocal_masker_level_plane_priority:rebalance_masker_level_before_pocket_eq_or_ducking (WING OSC native_osc_path_templates_declared); vocal_intelligibility_dynamic_unmasking: vocal_masker_level_plane_priority:rebalance_masker_level_before_pocket_eq_or_ducking (WING OSC dynamic_eq_value_mapping_required); hold_for_level_plane_context: blocked_by:level_plane_context_review_required (WING OSC not_a_console_mutation). Selected WING OSC: Behringer WING Rack fw3.0.5 native_osc_path_templates_declared; native_supported=True; status=wing_native_osc_candidate_requires_absolute_value_readback_before_apply; live_write=False. Selected readback paths: fdr, in/set/trim. Selected readback status: wing_osc_readback_paths_declared_before_live_promotion.
